source.test: createNewServer(name:...) -- Paper archive-first shortcut, archive miss

notes: `if !usedArchive { ... }` (line 274) -- a metadata check that finds no matching archived filename falls through to the real download exactly as if `saveDownloadedJars` had been off, and (since it's still on) the freshly downloaded jar is archived afterwards via `archiveServerJar` (line 290) so the next server of the same version hits the shortcut instead.
